description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class CustomFieldAPITest for testing the CustomFieldAPI class in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin, specifically testing API endpoints related to custom fields, including get, create, update, delete operations, and their validation rules.

classes.name: CustomFieldAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for testing the CustomFieldAPI class, covering CRUD operations, validation rules, and exception handling for the custom field API endpoints within the OrangeHRM PIM module.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldService
methods.description: Tests that the getCustomFieldService() method of the CustomFieldAPI returns an instance of CustomFieldService.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single custom field by ID and checks the normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the getOne API method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating a custom field and verifies the returned normalized data.

methods.name: testUpdateChangeExtraData
methods.description: Tests updating a custom field with a change in extra data and checks normalization.

methods.name: testUpdateChangeType
methods.description: Tests updating a custom field's type in a scenario where the field is in use, expecting a bad request exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the update operation's API validation rules.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deletion of a custom field and expects a 'record not found' exception.

methods.name: testDeleteNoInUse
methods.description: Tests deletion of a custom field not in use.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for delete operation.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creation of a new custom field and verifies the normalized output.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the create operation's API validation rules.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests getting a list of all custom fields and checks normalization.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Validates the validation rules for the getAll method.
